senses.gloss: (neut. verb) to widen, be broader; to extend.
units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 31">Lev. R. s. 31</cite> <he>היו מקטינות … ומַרְחִיבוֹת וכ׳</he> (the windows of the Temple) became narrow towards the inside and wider towards the outside, in order to send light forth to the world; Pesik. Ḳumi, p. 145ᵃ, sq. Sifré Deut. s. 1; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 575:1">Yalk. Zech. 575</cite> <he>מַרְחֶבֶת</he>, v. infra.

<cite ref="Berakhot 57b:12">Ber. 57ᵇ</cite> <he>שלשה מַרְחִיבִין דעתו וכ׳</he> three things give a man comfort: a nice dwelling &c.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 7:5:1">Cant. R. to VII, 5</cite> <he>עתידה</he> … <he>מִתְרַחֶבֶת וכ׳</he> Jerusalem will be enlarged on all sides; Sifré l. c.; Yalk. Zech. l. c. <he>מרחבת</he>.
